parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6 and achieved val_bpb 1.0115. The model capacity boost seems to compensate for the fixed 5-minute budget. Next: testing higher learning rate with this deeper architecture to see if we can optimize convergence further.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 with the new DEPTH=6 configuration to push convergence speed.
